theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ j, IsC1Submanifold n (N j) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N j) < ∞) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ j, N j
